description: Claim a Pending Review from the shared cross-user review queue so you are the one reviewing it. Atomic first-claim-wins — two reviewers cannot grab the same build. After claiming, run review_submit to record your verdict. Owner-or-active-member only. Does not call the Anthropic API.

task_id.description: The In Review task to claim for review, e.g. "task-2072".

name: review_claim
